acer.definitionKo: 보면서 즐기기 위해 심고 가꾸는 나무.
acer.englishDescription: Tree planted and grown for admiration and enjoyment.

aching.definitionKo: 다치거나 병이 생겨 통증이나 괴로움을 느끼다.
aching.englishDescription: Feeling pain or suffering due to an injury or illness.

aching.definitionKo: 몸의 어떤 부분을 많이 사용해서 피로나 괴로움을 느끼다.
aching.englishDescription: Feeling fatigue or suffering from overuse of a body part.

aching.definitionKo: 슬픔이나 연민으로 마음에 괴로운 느낌이 있다.
aching.englishDescription: Feeling pain in the heart due to sadness or a lingering attachment.

aching.definitionKo: 마음이나 정신에 자극을 받아 마음이 순간적으로 약간 흥분되고 떨리는 듯하다.
aching.englishDescription: Feeling agitated and nervous a bit for a moment with one's heart or mind being affected by something.

adequate.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 조건에 꼭 들어맞아 알맞다.
adequate.englishDescription: Suitable thanks to the quality of fully meeting certain requirements or conditions.
Meeting requirements or conditions, or being appropriate in terms of degree.

admirer.englishDescription: A person who admires and respects someone or something.

admit.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 끼게 하거나 단체에 속하게 하다.
admit.englishDescription: To make someone join in doing something or join a group.

admit.definitionKo: 어떤 내용이나 사실이 맞거나 그러하다고 인정하다.
admit.englishDescription: To admit that a content or fact is right.
To tolerate something with a generous mind.

admit.definitionKo: 어떤 조직이나 단체 등의 구성원으로 들어오게 하다.
admit.englishDescription: To let someone join a certain organization, group, etc., as a new member.

admit.definitionKo: 어떤 사실, 상태 등을 인정하거나 이해하고 수용하다.
admit.englishDescription: To admit, understand, or accept a certain fact, state, etc.
To admit to or accept something as it is.

admit.definitionKo: 자기가 저지른 잘못이나 죄를 남들 앞에서 스스로 고백하다.
admit.englishDescription: To make a clean breast of one's fault or sin in front of others.

admit.englishExpression: tell; admit; let out; rat out
admit.englishDescription: (slang) To say what one has been hiding.

admit.definitionKo: 시험, 검사, 심사 등을 통과하게 하다.
admit.englishDescription: To pass an applicant, etc., through a test, inspection, screening, etc.

advertise.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 어떤 것을 소개하여 알게 하다.
advertise.englishDescription: To tell someone about something so that he/she knows it.

advertise.definitionKo: 텔레비전이나 신문 등을 통하여 어떠한 정보를 사람들에게 널리 알리다.
advertise.englishDescription: To make certain information known to people via television, newspaper, etc.

advertise.definitionKo: 어떤 주의나 주장, 사물의 좋은 점 등을 사람들에게 말하여 널리 알리다.
advertise.englishDescription: To widely spread a certain idea, argument, advantages of an object, etc., by telling other people.
To promote a product, fact, etc., widely to a certain target.

affront.definitionKo: 낮추어 보고 창피를 주고 불명예스럽게 함.
affront.englishDescription: The act of defaming, humiliating, and looking down on someone.

aftereffect.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 끝난 뒤에 남아 미치는 영향.
aftereffect.englishDescription: The lingering effects after a certain event ends.

aftereffect.definitionKo: 어떤 병을 앓고 난 뒤에도 남아 있는 증상.
aftereffect.englishDescription: A symptom that lingers from a certain illness after the illness is cured.

aftereffect.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 치르고 난 뒤에 생긴 부작용.
aftereffect.englishDescription: A side effect that develops after one goes through a certain difficulty.

ambient.englishDescription: A mood or an ambient surrounding the place.

ambush.definitionKo: 적이 생각지 않았던 때에, 갑자기 들이쳐 공격함. 또는 그런 공격.
ambush.englishDescription: A sudden attack at a time when an opponent did not expect any, or such an attack.

ambush.definitionKo: 적이 생각지 않았던 때에, 갑자기 들이쳐 공격하다.
ambush.englishDescription: To attack suddenly at a time when an opponent did not expect any attack.

ambush.definitionKo: 숨어 있다가 적을 기습하기 위하여 적이 지나갈 만한 길목에 군사를 숨기는 것. 또는 그 군사.
ambush.englishDescription: The act of positioning soldiers hidden in a strategic spot where the enemy is likely to pass for a surprise attack; or such soldiers.

argh.definitionKo: 걱정, 근심, 안타까움, 한탄의 느낌을 나타낼 때 내는 소리.
argh.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker expresses the feelings of worry, anxiety, regret, or lamentation.

argh.definitionKo: 매우 힘들거나 기가 막히거나 좌절할 때 내는 소리.
argh.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels exhausted, stunned, or frustrated.

argh.definitionKo: 원하는 대로 되지 않아 속이 상할 때 혼자서 하는 소리.
argh.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered to the speaker himself/herself when he/she feels upset because things do not go as he/she expected.

argh.definitionKo: 갑자기 놀라거나 쓰러질 때 내는 소리.
argh.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or falls suddenly.

artery.definitionKo: 심장에서 나오는 피를 온몸으로 보내는 핏줄.
artery.englishDescription: A vessel that conveys blood from the heart to the entire body.
A tube in the body through which the blood flows.

authorization.definitionKo: 업무를 결정할 권한이 있는 윗사람이 아랫사람이 낸 안건을 허가하거나 승인함.
authorization.englishDescription: The approval of a superior, who is authorized to decide, about a plan submitted by a subordinate.
An act of recognizing and permitting something.
An act of giving an official permission to someone.

authorization.definitionKo: 법에 의해 금지되어 있는 행위를 특정한 경우에 한해 허용하여 이를 행할 수 있게 함.
authorization.englishDescription: The act of allowing someone to perform certain acts forbidden by law, only in certain special cases.

authorization.definitionKo: 국가, 공공 단체, 사회에서 정식으로 인정함.
authorization.englishDescription: Official recognition by the government, public organizations, or society.

babbling.definitionKo: 아직 말을 하지 못하는 아기가 분명하지 않은 말소리를 자꾸 내는 행동.
babbling.englishDescription: A baby who cannot talk yet, uttering uncertain sounds.

babbling.definitionKo: 앞뒤가 맞지 않게 이러쿵저러쿵 말을 늘어놓음.
babbling.englishDescription: An act of talking incoherently, saying this and that.

basics.definitionKo: 무엇을 하기 전에 가장 먼저 해야 하는 것이나 꼭 있어야 하는 것.
basics.englishDescription: A thing that should be done or be in place before doing something.

blanket.definitionKo: 털 등으로 짜서 덮거나 깔도록 만든 얇은 이불.
blanket.englishDescription: A thin piece of bedding made of shag, etc., for covering one's body; a spread.
To cover something completely so that there are no uncovered parts.

blanket.definitionKo: 털 등으로 짜서 깔거나 덮을 수 있게 만든 요.
blanket.englishDescription: A large piece of cloth made of wool, etc., used as a spread or covering.

blanket.definitionKo: 잘 때 몸을 덮기 위해 천 등으로 만든 것.
blanket.englishDescription: Something made of fabric, etc., to cover a person's body when sleeping.

blanket.definitionKo: 따로 떨어져 있는 여러 가지 것을 한데 묶는.
blanket.englishDescription: Bundling a variety of things that exist separately.

blanket.definitionKo: 따로 떨어져 있는 여러 가지 것들을 한데 묶음.
blanket.englishDescription: An act of bundling a variety of things that exist separately.
To cover a thing or place quickly, completely.
To put something around a person or thing  to cover him/her or it.

blockhead.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 모자라는 행동이나 생각을 하는 사람.
blockhead.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who acts and think foolishly.

bluff.definitionKo: 길이 끝나 더 이상 갈 수 없는 높은 절벽.
bluff.englishDescription: A steep cliff which is the end of the road.

bluff.definitionKo: 실속이 없이 겉으로만 부풀려 보이는 기세.
bluff.englishDescription: One's spirit that looks higher than it actually is, without substance.

bluff.definitionKo: 실제보다 지나치게 부풀려 믿기 어려운 말이나 행동.
bluff.englishDescription: Excessively exaggerated words or action that is hard to believe.

booger.definitionKo: 콧구멍에 콧물과 먼지가 섞여 말라붙은 것.
booger.englishDescription: Dried substance within one's nostril, which is the mixture of nasal mucus and dust.

boosting.englishDescription: An act of boosting another's spirit or raising awareness.

borrowing.englishDescription: An act of lending or borrowing money or goods.

borrowing.definitionKo: 필요한 돈이나 물건 등을 적절하게 돌려씀.
borrowing.englishDescription: The act of borrowing necessary money or things in a timely manner.

borrowing.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건 등을 빌리거나 구해서 쓸 수 있는 성질.
borrowing.englishDescription: The quality of being able to borrow or obtain money or goods and use them.

borrowing.definitionKo: 다른 언어에서 단어나 문자, 표현 등을 받아들여 씀.
borrowing.englishDescription: The appropriation of a word, letter, expression, etc., from a foreign language.

boy.englishDescription: A child of the male gender.

boy.definitionKo: 식당이나 호텔 등에서 심부름이나 서비스를 하는 남자.
boy.englishDescription: A man who does errands for or attends to customers in a restaurant, hotel, etc.

boy.definitionKo: 아직 어른이 되지 않은 어린 남자아이.
boy.englishDescription: A young boy that has not become an adult yet.
(affectionate) An abbreviated word for a young male child.
(endearing) A bound noun used to refer to a boy.
A child of the male gender.

breakthrough.definitionKo: 적진이나 상대의 수비를 뚫고 들어갈 수 있는 기회나 방법.
breakthrough.englishDescription: An opportunity or method to penetrate the enemy lines or the defense of an opponent.
A condition to overcome a difficulty or crisis.
The act of penetrating an enemy's defense.
The act of surpassing a set goal or previous record.

breakthrough.definitionKo: 어려운 일을 잘 처리하여 해결할 방법.
breakthrough.englishDescription: A method to resolve a difficult problem and find a solution.

broad-faced.definitionKo: 얼굴이나 이목구비가 옆으로 퍼져 넓은 듯하다.
broad-faced.englishDescription: Having wide facial features, making the face seem broad.

budget.definitionKo: 필요한 비용을 미리 계산해서 정함. 또는 그런 비용.
budget.englishDescription: The act of estimating and setting aside necessary expenses in advance; or such expenses.

budget.definitionKo: 국가나 단체, 회사 등에서 수입과 지출을 미리 계산해 돈을 어떻게 사용할 것인지 계획을 세움. 또는 그 계획.
budget.englishDescription: The act of developing a plan for where money will be spent by estimating income and expenses in a government, organization, company, etc.; or such a plan.

bustlingly.definitionKo: 급하게 서두르거나 시끄럽게 떠들어서 어수선한 느낌이 있게.
bustlingly.englishDescription: In a chaotic state of mind as one must hurry or there is so much noise.
In a chaotic state of mind as one must hurry or there is so much noise.
In an excessively disorderly, confusing manner.
In an excessively disorderly, confusing manner.

calumny.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 공개적으로 낮추어 보고 창피를 주고 불명예스럽게 하여 성립하는 범죄.
calumny.englishDescription: The crime of publicly defaming, humiliating and looking down on someone.

canceled.definitionKo: 정기적으로 다니는 배나 비행기 등이 어떤 사정으로 제때에 운항하지 않게 되다.
canceled.englishDescription: For regularly scheduled vessels or airplanes to not operate on time for some reason.

cane.definitionKo: 걸을 때 땅을 짚어서 몸을 지지하는 막대기.
cane.englishDescription: A stick used to support one's body as an aid in walking, as one places it on the ground.

cane.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물을 때릴 때에 쓰는 가는 나뭇가지.
cane.englishDescription: A thin branch or stick used for whipping a person or animal.

cctv.definitionKo: 감시, 방범, 화재 예방 등의 특정한 목적으로 특정 수신자에게 화상을 전송하는 텔레비전 방식.
cctv.englishDescription: A television method that transmits images to specific recipients for specific purposes such as surveillance, crime prevention, and fire prevention.

chaos.definitionKo: 어떤 물건이나 장소, 기분 등이 지저분하거나 복잡한 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: A state in which a certain object, place, feeling, etc., is disorderly or complicated.

chaos.definitionKo: 홍수, 지진, 가뭄 등으로 질서가 어지러운 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of being chaotic without order due to flood, earthquake, drought, etc.
A situation of social turmoil, confusion, and disorder.

chaos.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 뒤섞여 시끄럽게 하거나 어질러 놓은 상태. 또는 그런 곳.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of many people being in one place, noisy, and messy or a place in this state.

chaos.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 뒤섞여 시끄럽게 하거나 어질러 놓은 상태. 또는 그런 곳.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of many people being in one place, noisy, and messy or a place in this state.
(emphasizing form) A state of being a mess.

chaos.definitionKo: 말을 막기 어려울 정도로 여러 사람이 시끄럽게 마구 떠듦.
chaos.englishDescription: The act of many people speaking so loudly at the same time that they cannot be stopped.

chaos.definitionKo: 일이나 생각이 이리저리 흩어져서 갈피를 잡지 못함.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of things or thoughts being disorderly and confused.

chaos.definitionKo: 우주가 발생하기 이전의 어지럽고 질서가 없는 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: The state before the universe was created, which was full of confusion and lacked any order.

chaos.definitionKo: 마구 뒤섞여서 구분이 되지 않고 규칙이나 질서가 없음. 또는 그런 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of lacking rules or order with all things mixed up without being organized.

chaos.definitionKo: 하늘과 땅이 나누어지고 만물이 생겨나기 이전의 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: The state before the heavens and earth were divided and all the creatures came into existence.

chaos.definitionKo: 뒤죽박죽이 되어 어지럽고 질서가 없는 모양.
chaos.englishDescription: A state of being mixed up to become chaotic without order.

chaos.definitionKo: 정치와 사회가 불안정함. 또는 그런 상태.
chaos.englishDescription: A state in which a society and politics are not stable; or such a situation.

cheerleader.definitionKo: 운동 경기 등에서, 노래에 맞춰 춤을 추며 특정 팀을 응원하고 관중의 응원을 이끄는 사람.
cheerleader.englishDescription: At sporting events, etc., a person who cheers for a specific team and leads the crowd by dancing to a song.

chugs-puffs.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a train runs belching out smoke.

clef.definitionKo: 악보의 왼쪽 끝에 적어 넣어 음의 높낮이를 정하는 기호.
clef.englishDescription: The sign written down at the left of a score, to indicate the height of pitches.

coccyx.definitionKo: 등뼈의 가장 아래쪽에 있는 뾰족한 뼈.
coccyx.englishDescription: The pointed, bottommost bone of one's spine.

competence.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 수 있는 능력.
말이나 기교 등을 마음대로 능숙하게 다루어 씀.
competence.englishDescription: The state of having command of; for example, being able to utilize speech or a technique at one's will.

competence.definitionKo: 말이나 기교 등을 마음대로 능숙하게 다루어 쓰는 능력.
competence.englishDescription: The state of having command of; for example, having the ability to utilize speech or a technique at one's will.

competence.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 수 있는 힘.
어떤 일을 해낼 수 있는 힘과 능력.
competence.englishDescription: The power or ability to achieve something.

cone.definitionKo: 원의 평면 밖의 한 점과 원둘레 위의 모든 점을 연결하여 생긴 면으로 둘러싸인 입체.
cone.englishDescription: A three-dimensional structure surrounded by sides, which are created by connecting one dot outside a circle and all the dots on the circumference of the circle.
A state of looking like a cone.

confessing.definitionKo: 마음속 생각이나 숨기고 있는 사실을 모두 다 말하는.
confessing.englishDescription: Telling one's innermost thoughts or secrets in full.

confusing.definitionKo: 그런 것 같기도 하고 아닌 것 같기도 하여 알기가 어렵다.
confusing.englishDescription: Difficult to understand because it is not clear.

conjectural.definitionKo: 경험에 의하지 않고 순수한 논리적 사고만으로 현실이나 사물을 분별하고 판단하는.
conjectural.englishDescription: Discerning a reality or thing and making a judgment solely based on logical thinking without relying on experience.

conscription.definitionKo: 나라에서 병역 의무가 있는 사람을 강제로 불러 모아 일정 기간 동안 군인으로 복무하게 함.
conscription.englishDescription: An act of the government making people serve in the military for a certain period of time to fulfill their military duty.

conscription.definitionKo: 나라에서 모든 국민에게 강제로 병역의 의무를 지게 하는 제도.
conscription.englishDescription: A system in which the state imposes military duty on its citizens.

conscription.definitionKo: 나라에서 모든 국민에게 강제로 병역의 의무를 지게 하는 제도.
conscription.englishDescription: A system in which the state imposes military duty on all its citizens.

conscription.definitionKo: 전쟁 등의 위급한 일이 일어났을 때, 나라에서 강제로 국민을 데려다가 일하게 함.
conscription.englishDescription: An act of the government  forcibly or mandatorily requisitioning people in case of an emergency such as a war, etc.

conscription.definitionKo: 나라에서 병역 의무가 있는 사람을 군인으로 복무하도록 불러 모음.
conscription.englishDescription: An act of drafting people with military duty for military service.

consultation.definitionKo: 어떤 문제를 해결하기 위해 서로 이야기함.
consultation.englishDescription: An act of talking to one another to solve a certain problem.
The act of visiting and meeting a higher-ranking person.
The act of considering carefully and discussing thoroughly.

consultation.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 더 효율적이고 바르게 처리하기 위해 전문가나 전문 기관에 의견을 물음.
consultation.englishDescription: An act of seeking the opinion of an expert or a professional organization in order to deal with a matter more efficiently.
An act of a group of people sharing opinions with each other.

contemplate.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 깊이 생각하고 면밀히 연구하다.
contemplate.englishDescription: To study and contemplate something deeply and closely.

contemplate.definitionKo: 고요한 마음으로 사물이나 현상을 관찰하거나 깊이 생각하다.
contemplate.englishDescription: To observe or contemplate an object or phenomenon with a serene mind.

contemplate.definitionKo: 자신이 한 말이나 행동에 잘못이 없는지 다시 생각하다.
contemplate.englishDescription: To think again about whether what one said or did is wrong.
To be silently deep in thought with one's eyes closed.

contemplate.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 대하여 깊이 생각하고 그 근본 뜻을 찾다.
contemplate.englishDescription: To think deeply about a certain thing and search for its fundamental meaning.

contemplate.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 대하여 깊이 있게 생각하다.

contemplate.englishDescription: To think about something deeply and carefully.
To think deeply about a certain incident.

contemptible.definitionKo: 무시하거나 낮추어 보고 싶을 만큼 매우 싫다.
contemptible.englishDescription: Hating someone so much that one wants to ignore or look down on the person.

continent.englishDescription: Large mass of land surrounded by the ocean.
The land connected to a continent, not an island.

makeup.definitionKo: 배우 등이 옷이나 가발, 화장 등을 이용하여 극중 인물처럼 보이도록 꾸밈.

medal.englishDescription: An object worn over the chest, or a hat, etc., which is awarded by the government to a person who makes contribution to his/her country and society.

metro.definitionKo: 전기의 힘으로 철길 위를 달리며 한 번에 많은 사람을 태울 수 있는 긴 차.
metro.englishDescription: A long, electrically-powered vehicle that runs on tracks and is capable of carrying a large number of passengers.

modest.definitionKo: 남을 존중하고 자기를 낮추는 마음이나 태도가 있다.
